notes.evidence: Source inspection at the pinned revisions; no full inference observation claimed.
notes.producer: Ecto-Trigger deployment guide: TFLite interpreter get_tensor(output index)
notes.representation: Structure is the nested-list projection of the returned tensor, not an author JSON export.
notes.scope: Quantized TFLite deployment path. The guide uses model_weights/8/quant/8_int8.tflite; source inspection only, neither the released tensor nor physical deployment has been runtime-verified here. Unquantized Keras sigmoid output has a different floating-point representation.
notes.shape: Single-image deployment returns shape (1,1), with one image-level insect-presence score. Singleton schema arrays express repetition; the exact dimensions are documented here because the language cannot constrain a repeated array length to one.
notes.values: Raw unsigned byte in [0,255]. This is not a floating-point probability in [0,1]; converting back to model units requires the output tensor quantization scale and zero point. No bounding boxes, instance classes or counts are returned.
